title: Plurai Simulation
lede: Plurai Simulation runs from inside a coding agent and builds a sandboxed copy of an AI agent's environment, so test personas can exercise it and evals can check what it actually changed.

points: Pointed at a repo, it rebuilds the agent's tools, records and documents from the code into one consistent world state.
It mocks what should be mocked while keeping parts such as a RAG pipeline live, and never touches production.
Personas range from cooperative to hostile; evals grade the effect on that world, not what the transcript claims.
Production failures can be replayed from the step where they broke, and each bug comes with a proposed fix run three times.
It installs as a Claude Code plugin and also works from Codex and GitHub Copilot.

sections.text: Teams shipping tool-using agents, such as support bots that issue refunds, who need to confirm an action really happened rather than trusting the chat log.
The launch comment says teams can connect an agent and start for free; paid tiers are not described.
